title: The Overresponsible AI Handbook: An Alphabetical Guide to Doing Nothing, Responsibly
description: A satirical A-to-Z alphabet book on AI governance theater: twenty-six letters, each pairing a koan, a full-page illustration, and a one-line definition, with a bonus section of twenty-six coloring pages. Written and illustrated in April 2025 and presented as it was made, the book skewers what happens when responsible-AI practice curdles into pure process, while its front and back matter make the sincere case underneath the satire.
